Second, the flow-conservation constraint in Eq. (2),

\[
\sum_j f_{ij} = d_i z_i, \quad \forall i \in CAV,
\]

does not appear to account for transit traffic received from upstream CAVs. In a multi-hop relay network, a relaying CAV should forward both its own generated traffic and traffic received from other CAVs. A standard flow-conservation equation would involve incoming and outgoing flows, for example,

\[
\sum_j f_{ij} - \sum_k f_{ki} = d_i z_i,
\]

or an equivalent formulation depending on the direction of flow. As written, each CAV’s outgoing flow is constrained only by its own demand, which seems incompatible with multi-hop aggregation.
